transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess... work is what finally scared people enough to tell me to come in. I’m a waitress, and I started freezing up in the middle of service. Or I’d do things in the wrong order, like just standing by the soda station holding the cash drawer key and repeating table numbers instead of closing out checks. It upset my coworkers, and honestly it scared me too.
When this happens at work, do you later realize there are parts of that time you can’t remember?
I’m not sure. I mean, I remember being there, but some parts are kind of blurry. I haven’t really noticed a total blank spot or anything like that.
When you freeze up like that, do you suddenly feel a strong wave of fear or panic?
Not really a strong panic feeling, no. I get tense and confused, and I know something is wrong, but it doesn’t feel like a sudden wave of fear exactly.
During these episodes, do you hear voices that other people can't hear?

Yes. Not all the time, but sometimes when I’m closing at work, or even at home in the kitchen, I hear a woman’s voice. She’ll say my name, or say I’m doing the count wrong. It sounds clear enough that I’ve answered out loud before I realize nobody else heard it.
When you hear this woman’s voice, does it seem to come from outside you, like someone in the room speaking?
Yeah, it feels like it’s outside of me. Like someone is in the room or nearby saying my name, or telling me I’m doing the count wrong. It’s clear enough that I’ve answered before I catch myself.
Do you ever hear the woman’s voice when you are not having one of those freezing or confused episodes?

Yes, sometimes. It’s not only when I freeze up or get confused. Like when I’m closing at work doing the count, or when I’m at home in the kitchen, I’ll hear her say my name or say I’m doing something wrong. It sounds real enough that I’ve answered before I realize no one else heard it.
Did these problems start after any head injury, seizure, fainting spell, or other medical illness?
I don’t think so. I mean, not that I can remember. I didn’t have some accident or seizure or anything like that before it started.
Do you believe someone is deliberately trying to harm you or control you?

Yeah… I do feel like that sometimes. At work especially, I keep thinking a couple of the other servers, and this one regular customer, are watching how I ring things in. Like they’re checking up on me.

And sometimes there’ll be little marks or notes on the tickets, or mistakes with them, and it feels like they’re leaving signs to show they’re trying to get me fired. My husband says it’s just normal restaurant mess-ups, but it doesn’t feel that way to me.
For at least one full month, have you been hearing the woman’s voice or feeling that people are trying to get you fired?
Yes. It’s been longer than a month. The voice being clearer, and me really feeling like coworkers or that customer are trying to get me fired… that’s been going on for about four months now.
From when these problems first began until now, has it been less than six months?
No, it’s been more than six months. The whole change in me has been building for about a year and two months now, since I was asked to take on the evening shift lead responsibilities.
Since these problems began, have you been less able to manage your day-to-day life than before?

Yes. I’m not handling things like I used to. At work I’m making more mistakes and getting confused during service and closing, and it’s gotten bad enough that I’m close to losing the shift-lead chance they gave me.

At home too… my husband says I’m barely present with him anymore. I’m there, but I’m not really there.
Have you found yourself showing much less emotion on your face or in your voice than you used to?

Yeah… I think so. I don’t really do the things I used to enjoy, like beach walks, baking, gardening, or writing in my journal. And when my husband talks to me, I mostly just sit there. It’s like I can’t get myself to care or even start responding much.
